title: eragrostis peregrina
intro:
Eragrostis peregrina, commonly known as Traveller's Couch Grass or Wanderer's Couch Grass, is a type of grass species native to the tropical and subtropical regions of Australia, Asia, and the Pacific Islands.

This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Eragrostis peregrina include its ability to promote tissue repair, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
